game.title.description: Name of the Cascade game card.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Cascade game card.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Cascade play button.

game.canvasLabel.description: Accessible label for the HTML canvas element — describes game and interaction.

score.label.description: Small uppercase label above the score number.

score.display.description: Accessibility label for the score display container.

preview.dropLabel.description: Small label above the current fruit about to be dropped.

preview.nextLabel.description: Small label above the upcoming fruit.

preview.droppingNext.description: Accessibility label for the drop card.
preview.droppingNext.notes: {{name}} is a fruit name like Cherry — do not translate fruit names.

preview.comingUp.description: Accessibility label for the next card.
preview.comingUp.notes: {{name}} is a fruit name like Cherry — do not translate fruit names.

theme.groupLabel.description: Accessibility label for the fruit theme radio group.

theme.optionLabel.description: Accessibility label for each fruit theme option.
theme.optionLabel.notes: {{label}} is the fruit set name (e.g. Fruits, Tropical).

theme.switchConfirm.title.description: Title of the confirm shown when the player switches piece set (Fruits/Cosmos) mid-game.

theme.switchConfirm.body.description: Body of that confirm: switching abandons the current game.

theme.switchConfirm.confirm.description: Confirm button: switch set and start a new game.

theme.switchConfirm.cancel.description: Cancel button: keep the current game and set.

event.merged.description: Live region announcement when two fruits merge.
event.merged.notes: {{fruit}} is a fruit name — do not translate it.

score.high.description: Small uppercase label above the best score (HIGH).
score.high.notes: Shown uppercase via styling; keep short.

a11y.board.description: Screen-reader label for the Cascade game canvas.
a11y.board.notes: Do not translate the game name.

a11y.boardHint.description: Screen-reader hint on the Cascade board: what double-tapping does, and that sighted players press and drag to aim.
a11y.boardHint.notes: A double-tap (the screen reader's activate) drops the next piece in the middle of the bin.

a11y.dropPiece.description: Name of the screen-reader action on the Cascade board that drops the next piece in the middle.

web.loading.description: Caption under the spinner while the web version of Cascade downloads its graphics engine (a few seconds on first open).
web.loading.notes: Do not translate the game name. Web only.

web.loadError.description: Error shown when the web version of Cascade could not download or start its graphics engine; a Try again button follows.
web.loadError.notes: Do not translate the game name. Web only. Plain, non-technical wording.

web.retry.description: Button under the load error that tries to load Cascade's graphics again.

result.mergeScore.description: Stat label on Cascade's win card: the points scored by merging pieces, before the time bonus is added. The card's big number is this plus the time bonus.
result.mergeScore.notes: Shown in a row of four short stat labels under a number; keep it short (it may wrap to two lines).

result.timeBonus.description: Stat label on Cascade's win card: the extra points for winning quickly (the faster the win, the bigger the bonus).
result.timeBonus.notes: Shown in a row of four short stat labels under a number; keep it short (it may wrap to two lines).
